instructions: LaminDBAgent reads the LaminDB instance in LAMINDB_INSTANCE (owner/name) with the lamindb library. Start with lamindb_instance. lamindb_search searches one registry, lamindb_query filters one registry by fields (Django style lookups such as key__startswith or created_at__gte), and lamindb_describe shows one record with its features, labels, storage path and lineage. Registries: Artifact, Collection, Transform, Run, Record, ULabel, Feature, Schema, Project, Reference, Storage, User, Space, Branch. Every tool only reads.

targets.name: hub
targets.title: A LaminHub API address you set (under lamin.ai)
